stem.text: The rate of an exothermic reaction is followed by measuring the concentration of a reactant at regular time intervals.
During the experiment the temperature of the reaction mixture is **not** controlled.
Which graph shows the change in concentration of reactant against time?

A.alt: Graph of concentration against time: a straight line falling from a high value at time 0 to zero.

B.alt: Graph of concentration against time: a curve starting high at time 0, falling slowly, then steeply, and levelling off at a value above zero.

C.alt: Graph of concentration against time: a curve falling steeply at first and levelling off near zero.

D.alt: Graph of concentration against time: a curve starting at zero, rising slowly, steeply, then flattening.
